name: Lafia

queries.query: Lafia Nasarawa cadastral parcel map official GIS land registry
queries.result: Found the official Nasarawa Geographic Information Service (NAGIS) site. It identifies NAGIS as the state’s official GIS data source for digital land administration, gives a head office on Jos Road in Lafia, and describes a land-administration/GIS repository. No public parcel feature service, viewer route, or downloadable parcel geometry was found.

queries.query: Lafia Nasarawa taswirin fili rajista filaye
queries.result: The search returned the same official NAGIS land-administration lead and no Hausa-language public parcel API or bounded parcel geometry. English is the operative language on the official NAGIS site; no local-language result was treated as geometry evidence.

officialSources.observation: Official state GIS agency site says NAGIS hosts digital land-administration matters, with a Land Administration System and GIS linked to a digital data repository. It describes 10 cm orthophotos for urban areas and lists the NAGIS head office at Jos Road, Lafia. This is custodian and claimed coverage evidence, not parcel geometry.
Official property-registration procedure page was reachable and supports NAGIS/Ministry of Lands land-registration workflow. It did not expose a safe anonymous parcel-map response.

Official NAGIS procedure PDF identifies the Ministry of Lands and Urban Development and Office of the Surveyor-General in Lafia as part of title processing. It is procedure/custodian evidence only; no parcel geometry or owner/title data was retained.

requests.outcome: Official NAGIS homepage retrieved. HTML and linked JavaScript were inspected; no map, WMS, WFS, ArcGIS, parcel, or geometry endpoint was exposed.
Official registration-procedure page retrieved. No public parcel viewer/API configuration or bounded geometry response was present.
Official property-registration route retrieved. It is an application workflow, not an anonymous parcel feature service; no login was attempted and no unsafe fields were requested.
Robots response retrieved; it did not reveal a public parcel data endpoint.
No sitemap was available. This is not evidence of parcel-source absence.

registryBasis: NAGIS is a local/state-scoped GIS and land-administration custodian with a Lafia head office, and official procedure material names the Nasarawa Ministry of Lands and Urban Development/Office of the Surveyor-General in Lafia.
